links.outcome: LLM concordance and accuracy versus ICAR-O olfaction guideline recommendations
links.effect: Mean accuracy 1.85 (ChatGPT) and 1.48 (Gemini) out of 2; concordance 78.57% (33/42) ChatGPT and 66.67% (28/42) Gemini; ChatGPT more accurate than Gemini (p = 0.001).
links.quote: However, overall, both platforms did not consistently align with clinical guidelines.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and Gemini) against clinical guidelines on olfaction using an offline benchmark/query evaluation, evaluating baseline accuracy and concordance without testing specific deployment safeguards.
